card.text: HD 219666 b was found in 2018 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 219666 b"
sources.quote: HD 219666b is a hot Neptune type exoplanet that orbits around the G-type main sequence star named HD 219666.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HD 219666. Its orbit and size follow Murphy et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It orbits the star at a distance of 0.06 AU with an orbital period of 6.03 days.
